data.name: Marlene
data.gender_notes: Marlene is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mar- meaning little + lena meaning warrior woman. The name Marlene is derived from the Old Germanic name Marlana or Maralene, which is a combination of the elements Mar meaning 'little' and hild meaning 'warrior'. In English, the name Marlene has the meaning 'little darling' or 'little helper'. The name Marlene carries the meaning “Marla + Runa: little warrior woman” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Marlene usually hope their child will grow to embody marla + runa: little warrior woman and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Marlene belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Marla + Runa: little warrior woman.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Marlene total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: מרלן
in_hebrew.meaning: מקור השם: מאריה + לנה, כבוד + אור
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מרלן מגיעה משמות האם העבריים 'מאריה' (כבוד) ו'לנה' (אור). השם הושפע מדמות הבתולה מריה, אם ישו, בברית החדשה. שם נשי שמשמעו: 'אור הכבוד' או 'כבוד האור'. במסורת היהודית, 'מאר' נכתב 'מר' ו'כ' נכתב 'כ'. 'לנ' נכתב 'ל' ו'נה' נכתב 'נ'.

in_greek.name: Μαρλένα
in_greek.meaning: Πηγή του ονόματος: Μαρία + Λένα, τιμή + φως
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Μαρλένα προέρχεται από τα ελληνικά ονόματα 'Μαρία' (τιμή) και 'Λένα' (φως). Ονομάστηκε έτσι από την Παναγία Μαρία, μητέρα του Ιησού, στην Καινή Διαθήκη. Ονοματοθεσία θηλέων που σημαίνει: 'φως της τιμής' ή 'τιμή του φωτός'.

in_latin.name: Marlene
in_latin.meaning: Origine auctoris: Maria + Lena, honor + lux
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Marlene originatur a nominibus femininis 'Maria' (honor) et 'Lena' (lux). Nomen a Maria, Dei Genitrix, inspiratum est. Nomina feminea significans: 'lux honoris' vel 'honor lux'.

in_english.name: Marlene
in_english.meaning: Originating from Mary and Helen, honor and light
in_english.long_meaning: The name Marlene originates from the Hebrew names 'Mary' (honor) and 'Helen' (light). Named after the Virgin Mary, mother of Jesus, in the New Testament. A feminine name meaning: 'light of honor' or 'honor of light'. Marlene is also used as a variant of the name Marie, a French form of Mary. It conveys qualities of light, hope, and spiritual guidance, making it a popular choice for Christian parents seeking a name that reflects their faith.

pronunciation.biblical: Μαρία (Mary) and Λένα (Lena) in Koine Greek pronunciation

data.cultural_impact: The name Marlene gained popularity during the early 1900s in Europe and America, particularly in the 1920s and 1930s. It was especially famously held by the Austrian-born German actress Marlene Dietrich, who became an icon of both German and American cultures through her acting talents and her distinctive style and persona. Dietrich's charisma and versatility on screen led her to be known as the "Queen of the Silver Screen." The name became synonymous with elegance, glamour, and strength, inspiring many young women to adopt it.
data.spiritual_significance: Marlene, derived from the Old Germanic roots Mar meaning 'little' and hild meaning 'warrior woman,' speaks to the concept of small beginnings, inner strength, and protection. As a Christian name, it offers a reminder that no matter how small or insignificant our circumstances, we have the power and strength within us to overcome challenges and battle our inner demons. The name Marlene encourages us to remember our worth as children of God and to lean on our faith for guidance and strength in times of difficulty. Through the months of March (Mar) and May (the middle name Len(a)), this name serves as a reminder to embrace the spiritual warrior within and to trust in the Lord's protection and guidance.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Marlene: Sea to shield. A name evoking the protective and nurturing embrace of the sea, symbolizing the shielding and care of the divine in one's life journey.

biblical_reference.note: Named after the Virgin Mary, mother of Jesus

historical_references.reference: Marlene was a popular name for girls born around the turn of the 20th century, and may have derived from the name Marion or Mary-Lena. The name Marlene gained considerable popularity in the English-speaking world following the success of the German silent film actor Marlene Dietrich (1901-1992).
historical_references.context: Named after the German actress Marlene Dietrich

historical_references.reference: Another possible origin of the name Marlene is from the Italian name Margherita, which means 'pearl'. During the Middle Ages, 'Margaret' or 'Margarette' was a common name for girls, and over time, the name evolved into 'Marlene'.
historical_references.context: Derived from the Italian name Margherita
